topic.title: Question on rules: sharing aggregate stats and using third-party analysis tools
topic.author: Fernando Rodrigues

raw.title: Question on rules: sharing aggregate stats and using third-party analysis tools
Question on rules: sharing aggregate stats and using third-party analysis tools

firstMessage.content:
Hi organizers,

Two quick questions about Section 4.b (Data Security), to make sure I stay within the rules:

  1. Is it OK to share aggregate statistics derived from train.csv outside Kaggle (for example, a chart of punctuation rates per model, with no text excerpts), e.g. on social media or another community?

  2. Is it OK to analyze train.csv with third-party data tools (cloud notebooks or visualization platforms), or should the data stay only on Kaggle and local machines?

If either is not allowed, I'll keep everything on Kaggle. Thanks!
